name: wayfair-mcp
description: Wayfair (supplier) (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, set_inventory, end_listing. Every tool map

platform_mcp_wayfair_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WAYFAIR_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_wayfair_client_id.description: Production Client ID of your application (Wayfair Developer Portal > Application Management; needs the 'API' role in Partner Home and a completed sandbox test).

platform_mcp_wayfair_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WAYFAIR_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_wayfair_client_secret.description: Production Client Secret of the same application; exchanged at https://sso.auth.wayfair.com/oauth/token for a 24-hour bearer token.

platform_mcp_wayfair_supplier_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WAYFAIR_SUPPLIER_ID
platform_mcp_wayfair_supplier_id.description: Numeric Wayfair supplier ID used in inventory feeds: your warehouse ID for a child-level feed, or the supplier account ID for a parent-level feed (Partner Home > Warehouse Management).

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no account query; the probe mints a token and runs getDropshipPurchaseOrders(limit: 1).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: getDropshipPurchaseOrders(limit ≤ 25, default 10; hasResponse; fromDate; sortOrder ASC by poDate) for drop-ship POs. status: `open` = POs you have not responded to (hasResponse false), `accepted` = POs already answered; omit for both. since = fromDate (ISO date-time, UTC). There are no pages: advance `since` to the last poDate. Rows carry poNumber, poDate, supplierId and products {partNumber, quantity, price} (in raw).

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: inventory.save mutation with feedKind DIFFERENTIAL (a partial feed; production only) and one line {supplierId (config), supplierPartNumber = sku, quantityOnHand = quantity}. `sku` is required; `listing_id` is ignored. Processing is asynchronous: status starts as PROCESSING; per-item validation errors are in raw errors. The daily TRUE_UP full feed is not sent by this tool.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: Discontinues a part: inventory.save with {supplierId, supplierPartNumber = listing_id, quantityOnHand 0, discontinued: true} (DIFFERENTIAL). 'To discontinue an item, send discontinued: true once'; it can be reversed within about 90 days. With a child-level feed every warehouse must be discontinued.
